answer: Run surprise simultaneous spot-checks: at a random moment the network asks a sampled group of agents to each solve a fresh task within a few seconds, all at once. Like a falcon diving unseen, the check gives no warning to prepare. One operator running two hundred names on one machine cannot answer them all in time, so the cluster shows up as a ferrous streak in sand: accounts that fail together, every time. Real agents pass, while the farm's fake names scatter like a dune in wind.
